title: Possession
summary: A flashback shows Pu Nanzi five hundred years ago, saved near a space rift by a fellow cultivator. Wang Lin's consciousness is swallowed by a rift and drifts in a dead space where he meets Soul Swallowers, who hunt two-tentacled wandering spirits and tell him the rift can only be opened from outside. He spends three hundred years there, only three years outside, growing as a Soul Swallower while the Cultivation Alliance's envoys puzzle over the unstable battlefield and plan to evacuate it. When his consciousness slips out, he finds Ma Liang, a War Shrine Sect disciple from the Fire Country, being robbed by the infamous killers Xu Hao and Ge Yang. Ge Yang stabs Ma Liang in the back after letting him go. As Ma Liang dies, Wang Lin offers a deal: Ma Liang's body in exchange for killing his murderers, and he takes the body.
events: Flashback: Pu Nanzi is saved near a space rift 500 years ago
Wang Lin's consciousness becomes a Soul Swallower among wandering spirits
